title: Object Storage: commitment cancel allowed
content:
Object Storage commitment cancel allowed is defined as follows: Whether customer termination forgives an unexpired signed commitment; boolean.

| Contract tier | Commitment cancel allowed |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB | commitment cancel allowed: not permitted |
| Northbridge Object Storage 10 TB | commitment cancel allowed: not permitted |
| Northbridge Object Storage 25 TB | commitment cancel allowed: not permitted |
| Northbridge Object Storage 50 TB | commitment cancel allowed: not permitted |
| Northbridge Object Storage 100 TB | commitment cancel allowed: not permitted |
| Northbridge Object Storage 250 TB | commitment cancel allowed: not permitted |

## Tier reference

For Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB, the commitment cancel allowed entry is not permitted.
